title: Rhea Care House Admission
objective: Adapt and admit the qualified minimum Rhea Care resident without introducing a duplicate store, orchestrator, scheduler, alert backend or repair authority.
laws: Rhea is Care, not Triad and not Kronos.
Rhea consumes current evidence; it does not own a sensor fabric.
Rhea never grants approval, starts execution, schedules work, builds, researches, admits memory, owns credentials or invokes LIFE actions.
Consequential repair requests stop at WAITING_FOR_AUTHORITY.
Talos remains execution-verification truth; Rhea verifies vitality only.
No private care store, scheduler, HubAlert backend, Genesis adapter or care workflow engine is introduced.
House admission requires manifest + Book + component contract + Atlas/Mnemosyne derived evidence + independent T590 proof.
